AppAccess.// GroupId: QA reads the QA access group (Origination App QA Users). Config is ready; filtering activates automatically once the app-origination-qa-eus managed identity is granted scoped read of this group + User.ReadBasic.All. Until that grant lands the member read fails and consumers fall open (unfiltered) — safe.

ConnectionStrings.// ODSDpConnection: Intentionally absent — DP contracts read ODSConnection above (QA ODS), same as every other ODS query. The DP Contracts tab stays empty until ODS loads ctrm.vw_GNTA70D1 in QA; no config change is needed when it does. See appsettings.Dev.json for why no cross-environment override is used.

Ctrm.// Source: QA opts IN so users can validate the producer screen's contracts and tickets against CTRM. The switch re-reads config on EVERY call, so an App Service setting override (Ctrm__Source = ods) flips the whole environment back to the ODS views immediately, with no redeploy - which is also how a tester compares the same producer both ways.
Ctrm.// GraphQlUri: The QA gateway, which is what Dev points at too: QA is the environment the API was validated against and the client secret is a shared nonprod credential. Note this reads the NONPROD Db2 library, not production CTRM - see the testing caveat in docs/application-context/CTRM GraphQL Data Source.md.
Ctrm.// ClientSecret: NOT set here and never should be. Supplied from kv-orig-qa-eus as secret 'Ctrm--ClientSecret' (Key Vault maps '--' to ':'), read by the app-origination-qa-eus managed identity - the same path every other secret in this environment uses. Until that secret exists the client reports NotConfigured and every contract/ticket read fails loudly rather than silently serving ODS.
